scope: S100 single-board offline only; no sensors, robot, device access, or control output

repositories.name: rdk_model_zoo
repositories.evidence_kind: S100 BPU runtime with frozen local files

repositories.name: mono_edgetam
repositories.reason: Official S100 HBM pipeline requires ament/colcon plus TROS dnn_node, hbm_img_msgs, hobot_cv and ai_msgs; none are installed and system installation is outside the confirmed boundary.

repositories.name: hobot_stereonet
repositories.reason: Official S100 ROS path is not installed; selective standalone rebuild additionally needs Git LFS model/runtime payloads and a separately verified S100 build contract. PointNet is the deployed D4 3D fixture instead.

repositories.name: hobot_centerpoint
repositories.reason: Official local point-cloud playback requires tros-humble-hobot-centerpoint and websocket packages that are not installed; apt changes are not authorized.

repositories.name: walk-these-ways
repositories.reason: The public deployment is Unitree Go1-specific and includes a low-level robot control path; it is neither an S100 deployment nor a verified 23-joint Roboto contract.

repositories.name: ASAP
repositories.reason: The released training and motion contracts target Unitree G1; Roboto URDF, actuator model, joint order and observation/action contract are not available yet.

repositories.name: rdk_LeRobot_tools
repositories.reason: ACT is officially verified on S100, but export needs a trained checkpoint and dataset; the published board entry directly creates an SO-101 robot and camera control loop, so it is not executed in this phase.

repositories.name: WBC-AGILE
repositories.reason: The framework targets Isaac Lab/Isaac Sim and validated Booster T1 or Unitree G1 contracts; it is a future RTX 4050 training reference, not a current S100 board deployment.

d4_deployed_increment.tracking: ByteTrack with YOLOv5x detector on S100 BPU
d4_deployed_increment.dense_perception: Depth Anything V2 on S100 BPU
d4_deployed_increment.three_dimensional: PointNet part segmentation on S100 BPU
d4_deployed_increment.rl_control: No new internet candidate is honestly deployable without a robot-specific dataset/checkpoint or contract; D3 locked S100 BPU policies remain the offline deployment baseline.
